analysis:
Docs-only change to docs/reference/configuration.md (date bump plus a rewritten 'Cluster runtime facts' section describing that a signed release registers `cluster_runtime` via POST /v1/releases and a coordinator that accepts it derives cluster approvals, pair-serving grants and parity qualifications). No executable code, defaults or controls changed in the supplied units. I examined the visible head text at lines 485-949 (units 11 and 12): the env-var tables (MiMo, Flash-Next, DiffusionGemma, Bonsai, memory and media budgets, hash I/O, prompt cache, SSD prefix cache, resident recurrent cache, cluster settings), which appear to be unchanged context rather than modified ranges.

Threat-model relevance: T-041 (prefix cache) and its SSD settings are described consistently with the canonical text, for example the 1800s TTL cap, the 20 GiB reserve, DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE as the gate, and the HMAC names. Nothing in the visible lines loosens these. The new cluster_runtime paragraph describes a coordinator-side, platform-owned trust path (A-011/A-017 adjacent: release registration derives approvals and grants automatically). That coordinator logic is out of scope and unavailable here. The remaining head-side text, lines 950-1002 and beyond, appears in changed ranges but was not supplied in these units, and the patch excerpt is truncated. Integration should confirm that the description of automatic derivation of pair-serving grants from release registration is consistent with the release API key (A-005) authority model and that no threat-model update is needed for the new cluster-approval trust path. This is a documentation gap to confirm, not a demonstrated regression. No findings.
